newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary forint firms vs dollar in lively market.
newsitem.headline: Hungary forint firms vs dollar in lively market.

text.p: Hungary's forint firmed against the dollar in active morning trade on Tuesday, dealers said.
At 0823 GMT the forint stood at 155.44/49 against the U.S. unit, a marginal four pips weaker than the central bank's bid.
"Foreign investors' hard currency is flowing in, and this is likely to keep the forint close to the central bank bid for at least the next few days," said Attila Behan of ING Bank.
On Monday the forint closed at 155.60/65 against the U.S. unit.
